entry.title: [要対応] PHP: CVE-2026-126714 9.2 CRITICAL
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：要対応 PHP本体。標準のセッション保存で、書き込みが途中で切れるとログインなしでRCEになりうる。CRITICAL
→ 修正版のPHPに更新（対象版は説明文が途中で切れていて不明）

Partially overwritten session files can lead to remote code execution. The files session save handler, which is the default, writes updated session data into the existing session file without first clearing it. If a write is interrupted, the file can contain the beginning of the new session followed by the end of the old one, and bytes of an ordinary string can later be unserialized as objects. An attacker who can influence the session data, for example through session upload progress, and interrupt a write at a suitable point may inject objects, which can lead to code execution when the application contains a suitable gadget chain. Session data can also be corrupted. This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

entry.title: [要対応] Apache / nginx: CVE-2026-123633 9.2 CRITICAL
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：要対応 nginx本体。HTTP/2で受けてプロキシする構成でuse-after-free、RCEの恐れ
→ 公式の告知で修正版を確認して更新

When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use HTTP/2 for client connections and proxy client requests to a backend, a specially crafted request can result in use-after-free in the worker process, if this process is running low on worker_connections. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR. Impact: This vulnerability may allow remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the NGINX system or may allow a code execution. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only. Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

entry.title: [要対応] Apache / nginx: CVE-2026-123007 9.2 CRITICAL
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：要対応 nginx本体。HTTP/2使用時に認証なしでヒープ溢れ、RCEの恐れ。CRITICAL
→ 公式の告知で修正版を確認して更新

This issue affects NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source configurations that use HTTP/2. When NGINX processes undisclosed traffic, the flow control window can exceed the allowed threshold, potentially resulting in a heap buffer overflow typically followed by an NGINX worker segmentation fault. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR. Impact: An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to crash the NGINX worker process, corrupt its memory, or potentially execute code remotely. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only. Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

entry.title: [要対応] Apache / nginx: CVE-2026-118899 8.7 HIGH
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：要対応 nginx本体。TLSv1.3有効のsslリスナーで認証なしに無限ループのDoS。HIGH
→ 公式の告知で修正版を確認して更新

When using the listen directive with the ssl parameter in the http block with TLSv1.3 enabled, an attacker can use a specially crafted TLS connection to cause an infinite loop in the NGINX worker process while reading the HTTP request body. As a result, the worker process stops accepting new connections and processing existing connections. Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated. Impact: This vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) of NGINX. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only. Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：要対応 WordPress本体のRCEでKEV掲載。本体の更新中にログインなしでコードを実行される
→ 4.7〜7.1.3が影響。修正版に更新する

WordPress Core is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in versions 4.7 through 7.1.3. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window.

entry.title: [要対応] Node.js: CVE-2026-111497 9.2 CRITICAL ⚠KEV
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：要対応 Brotliの展開処理でバッファあふれ。認証なしで外から攻撃でき、KEV掲載
→ Brotliを1.0.10 / 1.1.1 / 1.2.1 に更新

A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) in Google Brotli versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream. Users need to update any Brotli libraries or binaries between 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 to the latest available version: 1.0.10 or 1.1.1 or 1.2.1.

entry.title: [要対応] PHP: CVE-2026-109619 9.2 CRITICAL ⚠KEV
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：要対応 PHP本体でリクエスト間の古いメモリ参照によりRCE。KEV掲載
→ PHPを修正済みの版に更新

PHP has various global state that temporarily points into request memory. In some scenarios, global state may not be correctly reset, or may be repopulated after being reset. The global state may then refer to request memory even after it has been freed. Subsequent requests may read or branch on this stale state before it is fully initialized. Multiple strategies can trigger this condition and produce remote code execution (RCE).

entry.title: [要対応] PHP: CVE-2026-109618 9.2 CRITICAL ⚠KEV
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：要対応 PHP本体のメモリ不足時の処理の不備でRCE。KEV掲載
→ PHPを修正済みの版に更新

PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. Some contexts may not properly account for this scenario and leave request memory in an uninitialized state before performing an allocation. The subsequent request cleanup procedure may read or branch on this memory. Multiple OOM strategies can consistently trigger this condition and lead to remote code execution (RCE).
